messages:
mike_support: Hey team, Acme Robotics' voucher ACME-DED-2026 auto-applied to their hosted eval account instead of the Dedicated tenant we provisioned. Provision failed when trying to reserve GPUs.

sarah_billing: ugh. Do we have the tenant/account IDs + allocation log?

mike_support: tenant: 8892-acme-prod
account_id: acct_0acme8892
promo_code: ACME-DED-2026
API trace (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/promos/claim -> 200 OK
payload: {"code":"ACME-DED-2026","account":"acct_0acme8892","target":"hosted_eval"}
alloc_event: {"promo_id":"promo_7721","target_sku":"hosted_eval_free_v2"}
```
Customer says they clicked redeem from our onboarding email which referenced Reserved Dedicated credits.

jonny_ops: Can finance reassign the promo binding? If not, do we issue dedicated credits and retract from hosted eval? Any side effects on billing lines?

finance-bot: auto-ticket created FIN-7891. Requires manual rebind: promo->dedicated_sku OR issue replacement credit. Approval needed from billing team lead.

sarah_billing: @jonny_ops @amelia_sales I'm flagging this as high priority. Amelia, this is on your onboarding queue — can you confirm customer impact (blocked on GPUs?)

amelia_sales: Yep, Acme hit a block during Dedicated provisioning (errors: quota mismatch). They're paused on integration. Need dedicated credits moved to acct_0acme8892's dedicated tenant 8892-dedicated. They are sensitive to timeline — enterprise trial ends in 48h.

mike_support: Steps I took: reproduced in staging by claiming ACME-DED-2026 -> allocation to hosted sku. I can unclaim if finance approves. Suggest flow: (1) finance unbind promo; (2) apply equivalent credit to dedicated tenant; (3) remove from hosted eval account to avoid double-credit.

jonny_ops: Agree. @sarah_billing can you check if the promo is one-time use or single-tenant binding? If one-time, unbind+rebind should be fine.

sarah_billing: Promo metadata: one_time=true, binding=first-claim. We can manual reassign but need ticket and approval. I'll escalate to Billing Lead.

(10m later)

sarah_billing: Billing Lead approved manual rebind. FIN-7891 updated.

finance-bot: FIN-7891 status -> in_progress by sarah_billing

(12m later)

sarah_billing: Done — reallocated promo to dedicated tenant 8892-dedicated and removed hosted_eval allocation. Transaction id tx_5frewire. Applied 1000 trial credits to dedicated SKU. Please validate provisioning.

mike_support: Verified: provisioning succeeded after credits applied. Dedicated pool reserved. Provision logs:
```
reserve_gpu -> 200 OK
provision_status: success
```

amelia_sales: Customer notified, they confirmed Dedicated instance is green. Thanks team :tada:

mike_support: Closing FIN-7891. I'll follow up with postmortem on onboarding flow to prevent promo binding confusion.

sarah_billing: Adding a note to billing playbook about promo links in onboarding emails.

mike_support: thx all, closing thread.
